As Massachusetts voters head to the primary polls, progressive leader AOC throws her weight behind longtime incumbent Sen. Ed Markey against challenger Seth Moulton.

The Bright Side:
Transparent ideological alignment where voters clearly understand the progressive coalition supporting the incumbent senator's climate record.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The stated intent frames this as a monumental class struggle, while reality reveals it as standard intra-party primary coalition building.

Social Physics Analysis:
Political alliances form around shared goals and ideological loyalty. Transparent endorsement replaces hidden backroom deals with open factional backing.

The Trajectory: The Path of Redemption.
When political endorsements match ideological track records, it plots a stable trajectory toward collaborative coalition building.

The Unavoidable Truth: Political endorsements shape voter alignment in crowded primary elections.

The Unavoidable Lie: Endorsements alone solve systemic economic inequality without legislative power.
